initialPrompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one highly polished website UI concept board for Wedding Market's boutique fitting visit request. This is a DESIGN PREVIEW ONLY, not code. Wide landscape board, about 75% desktop view and 25% tall mobile view on right, both showing the same option open as a modal over the existing website. Clearly label the option outside the UI at the top. Established style: warm ivory #faf8f4 and cream, espresso #332d27, champagne thin rules, GT Super Light-like elegant serif display headlines, Acumin Pro-like small regular sans-serif interface, restrained Lucia-style script accent only if useful. All body labels are SANS SERIF, regular weight. No botanical graphics, no heavy bold text, no black brutalist buttons, no giant empty margins. Realistic crisp legible Spanish copy. Underlying page visible dimmed behind overlay: Wedding Market wedding outfit detail, large ivory gown photograph at left, compact product information at right, top wordmark exactly WEDDING MARKET. Use the sample boutique name 'Casa Marfil', a small champagne square CM company mark, and selected outfit 'Marfil · Encaje floral'. Keep the existing shop context visible; the visitor stays on the outfit page. Provide obvious upper-right close X with generous target and a clear bottom action. This requests a preferred visit date/time, not instant booking. Never invent available appointment slots, confirmed dates, payment forms, personal name/email fields, ratings, verified claims or subscriptions. Exact small reassurance text: 'La boutique confirmará tu visita. La solicitud no reserva la prenda.' Required date and time clearly labeled 'Fecha preferida *' and 'Hora preferida *'. Supporting selected garment shown as a small photo thumbnail, not a dominant big card. Optional companion count, wedding date, approximate size, outfit budget, note belong to the flow; less important details may be within an expandable section or later step. Consent to visit policies must appear before final submission. Use 'Enviar solicitud' only on final step and 'Continuar' on intermediate steps. No need to show every field if a step or disclosure clearly contains it. Mobile layout must fit width, keep close and primary action accessible, with internal scrolling for long forms. No browser/device chrome or ornate phone frame, just clean website UI frames. Desktop and mobile are coherent and genuinely responsive. Option label exactly 'A — Modal compacto'. A calm CENTERED modal with one internal scrolling form, about 620px wide, modest 10px radius and soft subtle shadow over a warm dark translucent scrim. Desktop modal top has a small horizontal identity row (CM seal, Casa Marfil) followed by light serif title 'Planea tu visita' and one short explanatory sentence. Small inline selected-outfit strip with thumbnail and name. Under it two balanced date/time controls side by side, then a tidy optional 'Acompañantes' select. A collapsed fine-rule disclosure 'Más detalles · opcional' holds wedding date, size, budget and message, avoiding a wall of fields. A small expandable 'Políticas de visita' with summary '60 min · Hasta 2 acompañantes' and a visible unchecked consent box 'He leído las políticas de visita'. Bottom footer light ivory with one wide refined espresso button 'Enviar solicitud' and the two short reassurance sentences. Do not draw a calendar grid or availability slot options in this version. Mobile transforms to a near-full-height centered dialog with slim 12px outside margins, the same content arranged in one column with date/time pair where fits, clear fixed footer; dimmed original page still visible around edges. Efficient, elegant, practical and not cramped. Show complete desktop dialog and enough mobile body to understand the whole design.
